title: Purair® CAGEX Cyanoacrylate Fuming Chamber for Animal Research
meta_title: Purair CAGEX Cyanoacrylate Fuming Chamber | Air Science
meta_description: The Purair CAGEX cyanoacrylate fuming chamber is engineered to protect users and the environment in animal research labs during cage cleaning, bedding changes, and waste disposal.
meta_keywords: cyanoacrylate fuming chamber, animal research, cage cleaning, bedding changes, waste disposal, air filtration, air science
short_description: Engineered to meet the needs of the animal research laboratory, the Purair® CAGEX is designed to protect the user and the environment from animal dander or bedding material particulates generated on the work surface. The CAGEX incorporates carbon filters to absorb odor while optional HEPA filtration contains harmful particulates generated during cage changing and waste disposal operations.
full_description: Using innovative filtration technology, the Purair CAGEX creates a safe work environment over the widest range of applications in the animal research industry. Key features include a high-efficiency EC blower, energy-saving LED lighting, filter blockage alarm, improved filter clamping to eliminate bypass leakage, easy filter changes, a mounted waste container for rapid disposal, a durable chemically-resistant cabinet frame with easy-to-clean work surfaces, a hinged front sash for easy access, and an optional mobile cart for ergonomic use and maximum flexibility. The Purair CAGEX construction complies with current technical and safety regulations.
seo_content: The Purair CAGEX cyanoacrylate fuming chamber is an essential piece of equipment for animal research laboratories. Designed to protect workers and the environment, the CAGEX features advanced filtration technology to capture harmful particulates and odors generated during common tasks like cage cleaning, bedding changes, and waste disposal. With its durable construction, user-friendly design, and compliance with key safety standards, the CAGEX ensures a safe and productive work environment for animal research professionals.

Protection & Compliance.OSHA: OSHA Standard -29 CFR, Safety and Health Regulations for General Industry, 1910.1450: Occupational exposure to hazardous chemicals in laboratories. Part B, definition, laboratory type hood. Please consult your Safety Officer and/or Industrial Hygienist.
